name: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Compute
line: Run virtual machines and manage the guest operating system yourself.

free.text: Home region: 2 E2 Micro VMs, A1 2 OCPU/12 GB, 200 GB disk, 10 TB egress

cells.regions: Global regions; Always Free limited to home region

work.math: The home region's 1/8 OCPU and 1 GB E2 Micro, 50 GB boot disk, IPv4 address and 100 GB of data sent out fit free quotas. It may be reclaimed if CPU and network each stay below 20% for 7 days. Builds and domain are extra.
730 hours of E5 (1 OCPU, 1 GB) at $23.36 + a 50 GB volume at $2.125. 100 GB of data sent out and the IP address are $0. Subtotal $25.485 before tax, plus outside build and domain costs.

work.plan: E5 Flex + 100 GB volume + daily backups
work.math: $55.48 for compute + $4.25 for a 100 GB volume = $59.73 subtotal. The IP address and 100 GB of data sent out are $0. But 2 of 7 daily backups go over 5 free copies, and their cost is unknown.
